subject: Proposal: Dedicated capacity uplift + warm-pool scaling safeguards
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma@optiscale.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@optiscale.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity uplift + warm-pool request ahead of renewal

Hi Laura / Marissa,

Thanks again for the time last week. As we approach our renewal (contract ends June 30), we want to lock in a Dedicated pool uplift: an additional 16 A100-equivalent GPUs to support our increased peak traffic. We've attached a short workbook with current token volumes and projected monthly peaks.

Two asks we want to fold into the renewal amendment:
- A throughput guarantee during scheduled peaks (we target sustaining 2.5M tokens/hour for 30-min bursts)
- Explicit warm-pool behavior so cold starts during launches don't blow the latency budget (we'd like a warm-pool size and a max scale-up lag target)

Can Redwood propose concrete min/max replica numbers, warm-pool sizing (either % or absolute), and an SLA target for scale-up latency? If we can reach agreement on those items we can fast-track procurement and sign.

Attached: OptiScale_capacity_request.xlsx (token and QPS breakdown)

Thanks,
Emma Chen
VP Product, OptiScale
emma@optiscale.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@optiscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity uplift + warm-pool request ahead of renewal

Hi Emma — thanks for the attachment and for outlining the asks. We're excited to support OptiScale through the renewal.

Quick next steps from our side:
1) I flagged the workbook to Marissa and Marcus for sizing; Karthik will confirm any routing/placement constraints for your VPC.
2) Could you confirm expected sustained QPS during a 30-min burst and the 95th percentile latency target you want to hold? That helps us map to min/max replicas + warm-pool sizing.
3) We usually propose a 30-day trial period for new scale policies so we can tune autoscaler thresholds without long-term credits. Is that acceptable?

I'll come back with a proposed amendment draft by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Draft redlines + operational guardrails for OptiScale request

Team — I reviewed Emma's workbook and sketched redlines to be customer-facing. Key points:

- Proposed capacity uplift: add 16 A100-eq GPUs (reserved) in the Dedicated pool.
- Autoscale targets: set min replicas to 8, max replicas to 40. These map to ~2.0M tokens/hour steady and 2.8M tokens/hour burst headroom in our tests.
- Warm pool: recommend a warm-pool equal to 15% of max replicas (rounded up), which yields 6 warm instances for max=40. Warm instances remain in pre-initialized state and can handle immediate traffic without cold start.
- Scale-up lag (SLO): propose 45 seconds median scale-up to first-response; 95th <= 90s during scheduled peak windows. We can offer a 30s objective only if they take our managed preroll tuning (extra runbooks + 1-week warmup).
- Trial period: 60-day adjustment window post-amendment (during renewal year) where we won't apply overage fees if our recommended configs are used and we jointly tune thresholds.

I've attached a draft redline for the Dedicated SLA (redline-draft-Dedicated-SLA.docx). Please review edits in sections 2.1 (capacity), 3.2 (autoscale behavior) and 4.4 (credits & remediation).

Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Draft redlines + operational guardrails for OptiScale request

+1 on Marissa's approach. Two quick operational notes:
- Warm-pool sizing at 15% feels conservative cost-wise — suggest we offer an alternate: fixed warm-pool = 6 instances (explicit) OR dynamic 10% if they opt into our quantization/compilation profile (saves ~20% GPU hours).
- Recommend we include a max scale-up throttle of "no more than 2x replicas per 30s" to prevent runaway launch storms; that protects shared infra.

If those two items look good I can TL;DR them into the external email.

Marcus
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@optiscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, procure@optiscale.com, OptiScale Legal <legal@optiscale.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity uplift + warm-pool scaling safeguards 

Hi Emma — following our internal review, please find a consolidated proposal below (summary + next steps).

Summary proposal (opt-in terms for renewal amendment):
- Reserved uplift: +16 A100-eq GPUs added to your Dedicated pool (billing as a reserved capacity line item).
- Autoscale min/max: min=8 replicas, max=40 replicas (maps to projected steady and burst token volumes from your workbook).
- Warm pool: fixed 6 warm instances (pre-initialized) with option to reduce to 10% dynamic warm pool if OptiScale opts into our compilation/quantization tuning program.
- Scale-up latency SLOs: median scale-up to first-byte <= 45s; 95th percentile <= 90s during scheduled peak windows. We can target median <= 30s if you accept a 7-day managed preroll where our infra team tunes kernels and batching thresholds.
- Launch throttle: cap scale-up velocity at 2x replicas per 30s to protect global scheduler stability.
- Trial & credits: 60-day tuning window after amendment where overage fees are paused if Redwood is engaged on tuning. If SLOs are missed after joint tuning, credit schedule in section 4.4 applies.

Next steps:
1) If this is acceptable, I'll attach an amendment PDF and a DocuSign link for signature.
2) Procurement: please confirm billing contact and PO cadence so we can align contract start on July 1.
3) Technical kickoff: propose Wed, May 26 for a 60-minute runbook alignment (Marcus & Karthik to lead).

Attached: SLA-amendment-OptiScale.pdf (redlines incorporated)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/recipient/123abc-SLA-amend
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/OPTI-2027-47

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through any line items.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
